units: metres, Z up; object width X, depth Y, height Z; fronts face local -Y

interactions.phases: Standard operations: approach, reach, operate, release. Window vault: open prerequisite, walk/run approach, bilateral hand support, body passage, landing and recovery.

vault_window.closed_window_policy: For an unspecified default closed window, set it open before video begins and record initial clearance preparation in executed_scene_plan.preconditions_applied. No unattended opening is animated. Explicit keep-closed, open-then-vault and glass breaking requests are unsupported.
vault_window.execution_limits: Vault requires width >= 1.0 m, height >= 1.0 m and sill height 0.55..1.05 m. Actual deformed skin passage clearance, reach, continuous passage and landing are checked by the executor; infeasible dimensions fail without changing user dimensions or widening validation.

limitations: Chair sitting, lifting, destruction and combat mixed with object interaction are not installed.
Window vault must be the only object interaction and the final action; mixing with explicit open/close operations, additional vaults or combat is not installed.

pass_door.initial_state_requirement: Door must already be open initially or by an earlier open_door event. Never silently open a closed door for passage.
pass_door.chain_limits: Single actor, one door and at most one passage. Only the same door open/pass/close events. Fixed-frame inside is local -Y; outside is local +Y. infer opening/closing door_side from passage direction and prior side transitions. No independent single_plan.locomotion, combat, running or other interactions.
pass_door.execution_limits: Actual animated leaf/frame/skin clearance, handle reach, safe passage route and timing are checked by the executor. Reject infeasible width, angle, obstacles or duration; do not modify explicit user dimensions or timing.
pass_door.operation_contact: Specialized pass chain uses visible near-hinge pull bars and animated contact_front/contact_back surface anchors at radius 0.30m. Original far handle remains for legacy operations; do not claim far-handle reach for full 80-degree passage-chain operation.

planning_recommendation.policy: Only recommend when user did not specify duration, dimensions, angle or action times. Preserve explicit duration including 15 seconds; allocate safe action times within original duration or reject. The 30-second person-plan limit applies only to a saved, validated pass_door scene; other single actions and independent locomotion remain limited to 15 seconds. Preserve original asset default size and angle; actual geometry rejects infeasible explicit specifications without changing them.
planning_recommendation.explicit_hand_policy: Preserve explicit right; actual reach/contact/collision checks decide feasibility. Legacy interactions without passage keep default right.

camera.scope: Specialized passage-chain preset; keeps the full actor visible after closure. Legacy prop/window scenes retain their fixed oblique view; do not submit custom orbit or azimuth fields.
